name: Hammock Camp, Dinner Island Ranch Wildlife Management Area
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 12, 2026 research.
navigationDestination: Dinner Island Ranch Wildlife Management Area, County Road 833, Hendry County, FL (main entrance on the west side of CR 833, 18 miles south of US 27/SR 80)
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: Seventeen sites with a vault toilet (seven tent-only, ten for tents or small campers); a second campground, Kowechobe, has 20 sites that can flood. The entrance is on CR 833, 2.5 miles north of CR 846, so it is a detour off Alligator Alley rather than a roadside stop. The map point is OpenStreetMap's marker for the wildlife area, not the campground.
access: Free permit or reservation required before arrival. Stay limit: 14 consecutive days within a month, then a 14-day gap Camping is 'available year-round' by free permit, bookable up to 14 days ahead online or at (561) 625-5122. The area's 2026-27 hunt dates were not obtained; statewide Zone A general gun on private land runs Nov 21, 2026 - Jan 3, 2027, so expect hunters in camp. Camping outside the two campgrounds is prohibited.
